_note: Illustrative example: an anonymised App Store-billed meditation app with a 7-day trial. Scores follow references/scoring.md; evidence comes from references/evidence.md.
subtitle: Health & Fitness · iOS · 7-day trial · daily habit
verdict: A missed day wipes the streak with a guilt line, the notification ask fires at launch, and the trial date never appears in the app.

items.test: Replace 'You gave up on yourself' with a neutral 'Missed yesterday? Repair your streak' and one free repair.
items.evidence: Repairable broken streak kept 85.20% vs 68.66% (#R39, strong, lab); FTC confirmshaming

items.pattern: Make the streak easy to keep
items.test: One short session keeps the streak; the 20-minute daily goal stays separate.
Move the ask after the first session, tied to 'remind me at 8:00'.
items.evidence: Calm reminder after the first session (#R17, directional); Apple guidance A13

items.pattern: Trial-ending notice with what they used
items.test: Two days before the charge, a card with sessions done, the date, $69.99 and where to cancel.
items.evidence: Hypothesis (no in-app test); Blinkist reminder #R48 strong, bundled; flips in #R50

duration_note: Durations assume 800 trial starts a day: week-1 activity 45% for rows 1-3, trial -> paid 32% for row 4, a 10% relative change. Illustrative inputs.
